## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Verification

Explain the checks performed and their results. For code changes, run `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build`. For rendering/export changes, include browser-test results.

## Screenshots

For visual changes, add before/after screenshots with private information removed.

## Notes for reviewers

Mention limitations, compatibility considerations or setup changes.
